description: Runs the AccessLumens accessibility scanner (axe-core plus AccessLumens keyboard, focus and reflow checks) in a local headless browser and returns a 0-100 score and every issue: severity, WCAG success criteria, how to fix it, and each failing element's CSS selector, markup and the reason it failed. Works on localhost and other local addresses, public URLs, and local .html files or folders. Takes about 10-60 seconds per page. Re-run after fixing to verify. A clean result covers only what automation can detect: before reporting the work as done, also review the source for repeated buttons or links with the same name and alt text that repeats nearby text.

crawl.description: Follow same-site links and test up to 10 pages instead of only this one.

keyboard.description: Also test keyboard access: unreachable controls, keyboard traps, invisible focus, skip links, and reflow at 320px. Slower; turn off for a quick check.

max_issues.description: Most issue types to return, most severe first.

url.description: Page to scan: a URL (http://localhost:3000/checkout, https://example.com), or a path to a local .html file or folder.

name: check_accessibility
title: Check accessibility
